correctness.rationale: Explicit two-direction extension proofs characterize all query supports. Complement/reversal handle all eight patterns; a three-state trailing-run recurrence and a first-selected-position independent-suffix count prove all coefficients and dimensions. Independently implemented complete finite trace enumerations for n<=9 (Python) and n<=11 (C++17) reproduce predicates, face polynomials and extremality.

value.rationale: This gives a complete natural eight-case classification of the smallest genuinely local forbidden binary languages, with constructive all-assignment extension criteria and entire face polynomials. The two classes have different asymptotic VC slopes, and 010/000 provide an exact all-length same-shattering-complex but different extremality phenomenon with a strict defect beginning at n=4. These are structurally motivated results beyond routine counting or isolated finite examples.
